delivery_scope: Source-clock, unit-identity and matched-RUN feasibility; no replay-to-RUN association and no claim of completed PF replication
unit_pool: curated CA1 clusters; cell-type classification not assumed
processed_position_units: centimeters per pinned recording_io.py; first LED x/y as in source loader
position_reconciliation: Every ProcessedPos row must match source reconstruction in time and first-LED coordinates. Removed rows may remain absent; backward/duplicate chronology is never sorted away.
nonoverlap_rule: Earliest supported pause per file, with +/-120 s matching intervals; keep zero-event pauses and do not select on replay content
theta_reference_rule: lowest numbered non-bad downsampled CA1 channel per annotated hemisphere; no maximum-power or outcome-based channel selection
claim_boundary: Source-code and numeric timestamp reconciliation is not a measurement of camera hardware latency. Available LFP is not proof of valid theta phase. Matched pauses are not replay events. Retain the PF missing-theta stopgate unchanged.
